messages.subject: Multiple Moderators using IndProd
parts:
Hi

I have written the following code to test multiple moderators using Lavaan.

library(haven)
library(lavaan)
library(semTools)
library(haven)
DataD <- read_sav("DataD.sav")


DataD.dmc <- indProd(DataD, var1 = c('RR1','RR2','RR3','RR4', 'RR5','RR6','RR7','RR8','RR9'), var2 = c('SC1','SC2','SC3','SC4'), match=FALSE, meanC=TRUE, residualC=FALSE, doubleMC=TRUE)
DataD.dmc <- indProd(DataD, var1 = c('RR1','RR2','RR3','RR4', 'RR5','RR6','RR7','RR8','RR9'), var2 = c('LC5','LC6','LC7','LC8'), match=FALSE, meanC=TRUE, residualC=FALSE, doubleMC=TRUE)
DataD.dmc <- indProd(DataD, var1 = c('RR1','RR2','RR3','RR4', 'RR5','RR6','RR7','RR8','RR9'), var2 = c('IC9','IC10','IC11','IC12'), match=FALSE, meanC=TRUE, residualC=FALSE, doubleMC=TRUE)
DataD.dmc <- indProd(DataD, var1 = c('RR1','RR2','RR3','RR4', 'RR5','RR6','RR7','RR8','RR9'), var2 = c('CC13','CC14','CC15','CC16'), match=FALSE, meanC=TRUE, residualC=FALSE, doubleMC=TRUE)

IDs.dmc.syntax <-
'
DC_SC =~ SC1+SC2+SC3+SC4  
DC_LC =~ LC5+LC6+LC7+LC8
DC_IC =~ xx*IC9+xx*IC10+xx*IC11+xx*IC12    
DC_CC =~ CC13+CC14+CC15+CC16  
RR =~ RR1+RR2+RR3+RR4+RR5+RR6+RR7+RR8+RR9+RR10+RR11+RR12
CMP =~ CMP1+CMP2+CMP3+CMP4+CMP5+CMP6+CMP7+CMP8


MOD_SC =~

RR1*SC1+RR2*SC1+RR3*SC1+RR4*SC1+RR5*SC1+RR6*SC1+RR7*SC1+RR8*SC1+RR9*SC1+
RR1*SC2+RR2*SC2+RR3*SC2+RR4*SC2+RR5*SC2+RR6*SC2+RR7*SC2+RR8*SC2+RR9*SC2+
RR1*SC3+RR2*SC3+RR3*SC3+RR4*SC3+RR5*SC3+RR6*SC3+RR7*SC3+RR8*SC3+RR9*SC3+
RR1*SC4+RR2*SC4+RR3*SC4+RR4*SC4+RR5*SC4+RR6*SC4+RR7*SC4+RR8*SC4+RR9*SC4

MOD_LC =~

RR1*LC5+RR2*LC5+RR3*LC5+RR4*LC5+RR5*LC5+RR6*LC5+RR7*LC5+RR8*LC5+RR9*LC5+
RR1*LC6+RR2*LC6+RR3*LC6+RR4*LC6+RR5*LC6+RR6*LC6+RR7*LC6+RR8*LC6+RR9*LC6+
RR1*LC7+RR2*LC7+RR3*LC7+RR4*LC7+RR5*LC7+RR6*LC7+RR7*LC7+RR8*LC7+RR9*LC7+
RR1*LC8+RR2*LC8+RR3*LC8+RR4*LC8+RR5*LC8+RR6*LC8+RR7*LC8+RR8*LC8+RR9*LC8

MOD_IC =~
RR1*IC9+RR2*IC9+RR3*IC9+RR4*IC9+RR5*IC9+RR6*IC9+RR7*IC9+RR8*IC9+RR9*IC9+
RR1*IC10+RR2*IC10+RR3*IC10+RR4*IC10+RR5*IC10+RR6*IC10+RR7*IC10+RR8*IC10+RR9*IC10+
RR1*IC11+RR2*IC11+RR3*IC11+RR4*IC11+RR5*IC11+RR6*IC11+RR7*IC11+RR8*IC11+RR9*IC11+
RR1*IC12+RR2*IC12+RR3*IC12+RR4*IC12+RR5*IC12+RR6*IC12+RR7*IC12+RR8*IC12+RR9*IC12

MOD_CC =~

RR1*CC13+RR2*CC13+RR3*CC13+RR4*CC13+RR5*CC13+RR6*CC13+RR7*CC13+RR8*CC13+RR9*CC13+
RR1*CC14+RR2*CC14+RR3*CC14+RR4*CC14+RR5*CC14+RR6*CC14+RR7*CC14+RR8*CC14+RR9*CC14+
RR1*CC15+RR2*CC15+RR3*CC15+RR4*CC15+RR5*CC15+RR6*CC15+RR7*CC15+RR8*CC15+RR9*CC15+
RR1*CC16+RR2*CC16+RR3*CC16+RR4*CC16+RR5*CC16+RR6*CC16+RR7*CC16+RR8*CC16+RR9*CC16

CMP ~ RR + MOD_SC + MOD_LC + MOD_IC + MOD_CC
'

IDs.dmc.fit <-sem(IDs.dmc.syntax, data=DataD.dmc, std.lv=TRUE, estimator="mlr")
fitMeasures(IDs.dmc.fit)
summary(IDs.dmc.fit, fit.measures=TRUE, standardized=TRUE)

Now when i see the names(DataD.dmc),  it gives the following list but not all the moderators only the last one

[41] "RR6"        "RR7"        "RR8"        "RR9"        "RR10"       "RR11"       "RR12"       "CMP1"

[57] "RR1.CC14"   "RR1.CC15"   "RR1.CC16"   "RR2.CC13"   "RR2.CC14"   "RR2.CC15"   "RR2.CC16"   "RR3.CC13"  
[65] "RR3.CC14"   "RR3.CC15"   "RR3.CC16"   "RR4.CC13"   "RR4.CC14"   "RR4.CC15"   "RR4.CC16"   "RR5.CC13"  
[73] "RR5.CC14"   "RR5.CC15"   "RR5.CC16"   "RR6.CC13"   "RR6.CC14"   "RR6.CC15"   "RR6.CC16"   "RR7.CC13"  
[81] "RR7.CC14"   "RR7.CC15"   "RR7.CC16"   "RR8.CC13"   "RR8.CC14"   "RR8.CC15"   "RR8.CC16"   "RR9.CC13"  
[89] "RR9.CC14"   "RR9.CC15"   "RR9.CC16"

>

The regression results look OK

Regressions:
                   Estimate  Std.Err  z-value  P(>|z|)   Std.lv  Std.all
  CMP ~                                                                 
    RR                0.334    0.153    2.185    0.029    0.319    0.319
    MOD_SC            0.023    0.127    0.178    0.859    0.022    0.022
    MOD_LC           -0.056    0.271   -0.208    0.835   -0.054   -0.054
    MOD_IC            0.038    0.053    0.715    0.475    0.036    0.036
    MOD_CC           -0.033    0.424   -0.079    0.937   -0.032   -0.032

May i know if the code is all good, but why cant i see all the interactions.

messages.author: 5abdb409f213d464
messages.subject: Re: Multiple Moderators using IndProd
parts:
That's what you asked for. The first indProd line says DataD.dmc <- indProd(DataD,...)
This stores the product indicators in the DataD.dmc object.
In the second and all following lines you write: DataD.dmc <- indProd(DataD,... )
So you use your original dataframe again and overwrite DataD.dmc. Correct is from the second line on:
DataD.dmc <- indProd(DataD.dmc, ...)
